measurements.evidence_quote: Figure 2. A) Zeta potential changes and B) DLS distribution of PNs in the absence or presence of HSA at different PFAS concentrations. PNs and HSA concentrations were kept at 1 μg mL-1 (0.374 pM) and 1 μm, respectively. || The as‐prepared samples were vortexed and placed in square polystyrene cuvettes and capillary cells, respectively, and then subjected to zeta potential and size distribution measurements with a Malvern Nano ZS90 Zetasizer (Malvern, UK) with a He/Ne laser (633 nm).

C) Hydrodynamic diameter and zeta potential changes of PNs due to the adsorption of HSA and PFAS interaction at pH 4.0. || The as‐prepared samples were vortexed and placed in square polystyrene cuvettes and capillary cells, respectively, and then subjected to zeta potential and size distribution measurements with a Malvern Nano ZS90 Zetasizer (Malvern, UK) with a He/Ne laser (633 nm).
